name: Goals / Outcomes
purpose: Top lifestyle outcomes such as sleep, energy, fitness, healthy weight and other validated goals

name: Symptoms & behaviours
purpose: The questionnaire answers, with explicit construct type

name: Nine functional domains
purpose: Modernised versions of the historical nine body-system domains

name: Cross-domain signals
purpose: Sleep, stress, energy, diet quality, activity, resilience and other constructs that legitimately cross systems

name: Safety / constraints
purpose: Medical treatment, chronic conditions, allergies, sensitivities and other recommendation restrictions

name: Recommendation matching
purpose: Foods, bioactives and products matched to goals + signals + constraints + evidence
